pages.text: Where liquefaction starts: squeeze solid ingredients into liquid energy (energy per ingredient):$(li)$(4)Nether Star → 1000 mb Nether Pure Energy: 50M$(0)$(li)Wither Rose → 400 mb Nether Compound Energy: 5M$(li)End Mixture + 1 solid → 500 mb End Mixture Fuel: 10M$(li)Dragon Mixture + 1 solid → 500 mb End Dragon Fuel: 50M$(li)the "World Base Fuel" ingredient (Golden Carrot + Sculk Block + Golden Apple + Akaishi Essence Block) + 1 solid → 100 mb World Base Fuel: 10M

$(bold)Stock up first:$(0) the last three recipes demand a solid as a medium alongside the main ingredient.$(br2)Nether Stars and Wither Roses are renewable; the End / Dragon / World Base ingredients come from the mixture routes covered in "Secrets of Life".$(br2)Settle the liquids in a tank, then feed the $(l:akaishi:fuel_processor)Energy Processor$(/l) or the $(l:akaishi:fuel_mixer)Fuel Mixer$(/l).
This is step one of the Liquid Fuel Chain — overview in $(l:akaishi:liquid_fuel)Liquid Fuel Chain$(/l); downstream processing and blending are linked above.
